source.creator: Kakeru Yazawa
source.reported_study: Yazawa & Kondo (2019), Acoustic characteristics of Japanese short and long vowels: Formant displacement effect revisited

population.description: 16 native speakers of Tokyo Japanese, ages 21-30

measurement.midpoint: temporal midpoint of each vowel interval
measurement.position_mapping_note: The source stores points as Fn_1..Fn_30 and describes them as 30 equidistant points within the central 60%. Formantasia maps indices linearly from 0.20 through 0.80 for display. No measured 0-20% or 80-100% endpoint values are claimed.

aggregation.step_1: For each sex x position x V1 condition, average the 10 raw tokens within each speaker.
aggregation.step_2: Average the 8 speaker means with equal speaker weight.
aggregation.uncertainty: Sample SD across the 8 speaker means.
